item.description:
# Weft 1.0.4
- Stop an individual service without stopping services that depend on it. The project-level Stop still stops the whole project. - Right-click a running service to restart it individually. - Show an immediate spinner on Start/Stop controls while the requested operation runs. - Add Pattern UI's Storybook development service on port 7007 with its own Open arrow. - Keep Pattern UI's dist build watcher separate from Storybook and Pi, so the development commands can keep updating files while other services run.
